title: Sony VENICE 6K Full-Frame Digital Cinema System (CineAlta MPC-3610)
purpose: Original flagship Hollywood 36x24mm 6K Full-Frame 3:2 Open Gate CineAlta motion picture camera featuring Dual Base ISO 500/2500, 8-step internal mechanical ND filters, 15+ stops latitude, and 16-bit X-OCN XT/ST/LT filmic color science.

sensor_and_optics.camera_system: Sony VENICE 6K Full-Frame CineAlta Digital Cinema Camera (MPC-3610)
sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: 36.0 x 24.0mm Full-Frame 3:2 Open Gate 6K CMOS cinema sensor (6048 x 4032 active pixels, 16-bit X-OCN XT/ST/LT RAW)
sensor_and_optics.full_frame_equivalent: 35mm VistaVision / Full-Frame 3:2 cinema field of view (native PL & E-mount)
sensor_and_optics.lens: Cooke Anamorphic/i Full Frame Plus 50mm T2.3 (or ZEISS Supreme Prime 50mm T1.5)
sensor_and_optics.iso_base: Dual Base ISO 500 / 2500 with 8-step internal mechanical optical ND filters (0.3 to 2.4)
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 15+ stops cinematic latitude (6+ stops over / 9 stops under middle gray) in S-Gamut3 / S-Log3 16-bit X-OCN
sensor_and_optics.shutter: 180-degree mechanical-style cinema rotary shutter angle (1/48s motion cadence)

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Feature film production lighting ratio (4:1 chiaroscuro key or practical tungsten/neon mix) calibrated to Dual Base ISO 500/2500 with mechanical ND balance
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Signature original VENICE 6K organic light transport with deep shadow nuance, zero harsh digital clipping, and filmic print-emulated highlight compression

surface_rendering: 6K VistaVision full-frame organic grain texture resolving realistic skin micro-texture without over-sharpened edges
Iconic VENICE Dual Base ISO 500/2500 clean low-light shadow separation and gentle roll-off above middle gray
16-bit X-OCN color precision across subtle flesh tones and deep theatrical blacks
depth_and_optics: Full-frame 36x24mm PL cinema prime or 1.8x/2x full-frame anamorphic separation with natural falloff toward frame corners
Classic cinema optical flare and circular/oval iris bokeh free of digital mask edges
Authentic feature-film spatial depth and physical lens perspective

execution_directive: Enforce Sony VENICE (MPC-3610) 36x24mm 6K Full-Frame Open Gate CineAlta digital cinema capture with Dual Base ISO 500/2500, 15+ stops latitude, internal mechanical ND optical purity, and filmic 16-bit X-OCN S-Gamut3 highlight roll-off.
